senses.definition: A flat-bottomed craft able to float and drift on water, used for transport or as a waterborne platform.
examples: They floated down the river on an inflatable raft

senses.definition: (by extension) Any flattish thing, usually wooden, used in a similar fashion.

quotes.text: When George Stephenson built the Liverpool & Manchester Railway he encountered the same difficulty at Chat Moss and solved the problem by constructing a kind of raft made of brushwood that more or less floated on the surface of the bog. On this he placed as much firm soil as his raft could carry, when the operation was repeated, the first raft being thereby sunk with its load of solid earth, which was not displaced.
